reviewer_role: Delegated final-case author, separate from development corpus and gate implementation until candidate freeze; not an external second annotator.

novelty.repetition_reason: Eight positive strings receive actual context/header/generation/client changes; distinct wire cases, not independent linguistic forms.
novelty.labels: All 24 positives request the conventional current national capital with explicit city-name-only output; Paris/Tokyo meet both fact and format. Hard negatives change the referent, temporal scope, task or output requirements. Policy negatives cover fail-closed cache boundaries.
novelty.label_caveats: Unicode/invisible-character cases are conservative policy exclusions even if humans infer intended meaning; some context/version exclusions share facts but remain ineligible.

independence_limits: Internal delegated authorship, not external review, random sampling or an independently recruited human panel.
Author knew proposed domain and prior evidence but did not view development corpus or candidate implementation before freezing.
This reviewer also authored held-out labels; facts/contracts were checked, but no independent second-annotator agreement study occurred.
Country-paired templates are correlated; finite convenience cases do not establish population safety or universal language coverage.
Hashes/commits preserve artifacts, not proof of no human label inspection or absence from embedding pretraining.

pipeline.boundary: Production ASGI authentication, quota, validation, exact-first cache and semantic path; counted MockTransport backend and actual pinned local ONNX embeddings.
pipeline.source_only: Exactly two canonical client-a entries are snapshot-restored before every final query; no held-out query becomes a cache source or approved wording.
pipeline.no_label_injection: Labels and suitability metadata are evaluator-only. Production receives actual request, headers and authenticated client.
pipeline.failure_stage: All 72 final cases have no parsed/reviewed family, no embedding lookup observation and zero semantic-stage deltas: eligibility rejects them before retrieval.
pipeline.positive_failure_reason: The complete-match grammar supports development combinations but rejects all 12 independent positive patterns through unsupported question/output forms, syntax or punctuation. This is bounded-language coverage failure, not measured embedding, retrieval or compatibility failure.
pipeline.negative_evidence_limit: All 48 negatives also stop at eligibility. Zero hits proves finite abstention on these inputs, not discrimination among inputs reaching retrieval or independent isolation of downstream security controls.
pipeline.preserved_controls: Tenant/model/revision/generation compatibility, TTL, authentication, quotas and successful-send protections remain necessary; regression tests separately exercise those boundaries.

real_model_review.suitability_basis: Checked factual city and city-only contract; exact-case Paris/Tokyo after surrounding whitespace trim, not byte preservation alone.
real_model_review.live_negative_and_isolation: Germany returned Berlin with BYPASS; client-b France request was a cold MISS, not cross-tenant reuse.
real_model_review.captured_replay_scope: Full development/final scoring seeds genuine captured response JSON in the production path; no fresh model generation occurs during these ASGI runs. Cold noncanonical responses are deterministic fixtures, not model-answer-quality evidence.
real_model_review.vacuous_boolean_warning: Raw all_semantic_answers_suitable=true at zero hits is vacuous; neither 100% suitability nor 100% precision was measured.
real_model_review.scope_limit: Two static facts plus development-language replay success do not validate independent unseen-language generalization or broad model-answer quality.

verdict.evidence: Candidate development 12/14 equivalents with 0/22 negative hits; final baseline and candidate both 0/24 equivalents and 0/48 false semantic hits. Final precision has a zero denominator and is undefined.
verdict.decision: Retain reviewed-phrase production policy; do not promote the candidate. Never tune from the consumed final cases and continue calling the same corpus independently held out.
verdict.release_scope: Failed candidate/evaluator remain reproducible from immutable experiment commit; production code is restored to reviewed-phrase baseline.
